name: Coverage
rule: declared, but taken by nothing entail knows: the config class does not take it and no reader of it is registered
note: not taken by the class and read by nothing entail knows: text_config.expert_intermediate_size, text_config.num_global_key_value_heads; read elsewhere: eos_token_id (read for generation: GenerationConfig.from_model_config builds the generation settings from the config's to_dict(), which keeps a key the class did not declare (transformers 5.17 generation/configuration_utils.py, from_model_config)); _commit_hash (read by PreTrainedConfig itself (transformers 5.17 configuration_utils.py, __init__ and from_dict): the hub revision the files came from)

source.where: transformers config class: a key is taken if the class knows it or its value landed in a field it knows

name: Vocab
rule: the consumer uses the declared value

source.where: tokenizer.json (the only tokenizer source; the engine's own count stands)
GemmaTokenizer built from google/gemma-4-E2B-it: the tokenizer the engine holds
